name: TD Capuchin 2
summary:
TD Capuchin 2: A Descent into the Unknown

In the eerie, desolate void known as TD Capuchin, the world feels like a nightmare pulled straight from your deepest, most primitive instincts. Inspired by the gorilla-tagging roots of the original, this fan game warps the sense of competition into something darker—an experience where survival is the only rule.
